meanings.en: to make someone laugh or smile; to entertain
meanings.exampleEn: The clown tried to amuse the children at the party.
meanings.exampleTr: Palyaço partide çocukları eğlendirmeye çalıştı.

meanings.en: a comparison between two things to explain or clarify
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher used an analogy to explain how the heart works like a pump.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen kalbin bir pompa gibi nasıl çalıştığını açıklamak için bir benzetme kullandı.

meanings.en: a person who examines and interprets information
meanings.exampleEn: The financial analyst predicted a rise in the stock market.
meanings.exampleTr: Finansal analist borsada bir yükseliş öngördü.

meanings.en: a heavy object dropped to keep a ship in place
meanings.exampleEn: The sailors lowered the anchor as the ship reached the bay.
meanings.exampleTr: Gemi koya ulaşınca denizciler çapayı indirdi.

meanings.en: a place where ships can safely anchor
meanings.exampleEn: The boats found a sheltered anchorage near the small island.
meanings.exampleTr: Tekneler küçük adanın yakınında korunaklı bir demirleme yeri buldu.

meanings.en: a male presenter who leads a news broadcast
meanings.exampleEn: The anchorman reported the breaking news calmly.
meanings.exampleTr: Baş haber sunucusu son dakika haberini sakince aktardı.

meanings.en: a person who presents and coordinates a news programme
meanings.exampleEn: The anchorperson introduced the next report from the field.
meanings.exampleTr: Baş haber sunucusu sahadan gelecek bir sonraki haberi tanıttı.

meanings.en: severe mental or physical pain or suffering
meanings.exampleEn: She cried out in anguish when she heard the terrible news.
meanings.exampleTr: Korkunç haberi duyduğunda ıstırap içinde haykırdı.

meanings.en: to bring to life or give movement to something
meanings.exampleEn: They used computers to animate the characters in the film.
meanings.exampleTr: Filmdeki karakterleri canlandırmak için bilgisayar kullandılar.

meanings.en: having an unknown or undisclosed name
meanings.exampleEn: The newspaper received an anonymous letter about the scandal.
meanings.exampleTr: Gazete skandalla ilgili isimsiz bir mektup aldı.

meanings.en: designed to attack or defend against enemy aircraft
meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers fired antiaircraft guns at the approaching planes.
meanings.exampleTr: Askerler yaklaşan uçaklara uçaksavar topları ateşledi.

meanings.en: able to destroy or stop the growth of bacteria
meanings.exampleEn: She washed her hands with an antibacterial soap.
meanings.exampleTr: Ellerini antibakteriyel bir sabunla yıkadı.

meanings.en: used to prevent or treat cancer
meanings.exampleEn: Researchers are testing a new anticancer drug.
meanings.exampleTr: Araştırmacılar yeni bir antikanser ilacını test ediyor.

meanings.en: to expect or predict that something will happen
meanings.exampleEn: We anticipate heavy traffic during the holiday weekend.
meanings.exampleTr: Tatil hafta sonunda yoğun trafik bekliyoruz.

meanings.en: the act of expecting or looking forward to something
meanings.exampleEn: The children waited in anticipation for the show to begin.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar gösterinin başlamasını beklenti içinde bekledi.

meanings.en: intended to reduce or prevent pollution
meanings.exampleEn: The city introduced antipollution measures to clean the air.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehir, havayı temizlemek için kirlilik önleyici önlemler getirdi.

meanings.en: old and valuable because of its age
meanings.exampleEn: They bought an antique clock at the market.
meanings.exampleTr: Pazardan antika bir saat aldılar.

meanings.en: preventing the build-up of static electricity
meanings.exampleEn: He wore an antistatic wristband while fixing the computer.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilgisayarı tamir ederken antistatik bir bileklik taktı.

meanings.en: software that detects and removes computer viruses
meanings.exampleEn: Make sure to install antivirus software on your laptop.
meanings.exampleTr: Dizüstü bilgisayarına antivirüs yazılımı kurduğundan emin ol.

meanings.en: the punctuation mark (') used to show possession or omission
meanings.exampleEn: You need an apostrophe in the word "don't".
meanings.exampleTr: "Don't" kelimesinde bir kesme işaretine ihtiyacın var.

meanings.en: a person who formally applies for a job or position
meanings.exampleEn: Every applicant must submit a CV and a cover letter.
meanings.exampleTr: Her başvuran bir özgeçmiş ve ön yazı sunmalıdır.

meanings.en: feeling or showing gratitude or pleasure
meanings.exampleEn: She was very appreciative of all the help she received.
meanings.exampleTr: Aldığı tüm yardım için çok minnettardı.

meanings.en: in a way that is suitable for the situation
meanings.exampleEn: Please dress appropriately for the formal dinner.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen resmi yemek için uygun şekilde giyinin.

meanings.en: close to a number or amount but not exact
meanings.exampleEn: The approximate cost of the trip is two thousand dollars.
meanings.exampleTr: Gezinin yaklaşık maliyeti iki bin dolardır.

meanings.en: a curved structure that supports a bridge, roof or wall
meanings.exampleEn: The old bridge was built with a beautiful stone arch.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski köprü güzel bir taş kemerle inşa edilmişti.

meanings.en: a person who studies ancient cultures through remains
meanings.exampleEn: The archaeologist discovered an ancient tomb in the desert.
meanings.exampleTr: Arkeolog çölde antik bir mezar keşfetti.

meanings.en: relating to the North Pole region; extremely cold
meanings.exampleEn: The explorers faced arctic winds during their journey.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaşifler yolculukları sırasında kutup rüzgarlarıyla karşılaştı.

meanings.en: a large enclosed area for sports or entertainment
meanings.exampleEn: Thousands of fans filled the arena for the concert.
meanings.exampleTr: Binlerce hayran konser için arenayı doldurdu.

meanings.en: the highest social class, typically of noble birth
meanings.exampleEn: The aristocracy once owned most of the land in the country.
meanings.exampleTr: Aristokrasi bir zamanlar ülkedeki toprakların çoğuna sahipti.

meanings.en: the amount that can be held in one's arms
meanings.exampleEn: She carried an armful of books into the classroom.
meanings.exampleTr: Sınıfa kucak dolusu kitap taşıdı.

meanings.en: to cause a feeling or reaction in someone
meanings.exampleEn: The strange noise began to arouse my suspicion.
meanings.exampleTr: Garip ses şüphemi uyandırmaya başladı.

meanings.en: a tube that carries blood from the heart around the body
meanings.exampleEn: A blocked artery can cause a serious heart attack.
meanings.exampleTr: Tıkalı bir atardamar ciddi bir kalp krizine neden olabilir.

meanings.en: in a way that is not natural, made by humans
meanings.exampleEn: The fruit juice was artificially sweetened with sugar.
meanings.exampleTr: Meyve suyu şekerle yapay olarak tatlandırılmıştı.

meanings.en: great skill in a creative or artistic activity
meanings.exampleEn: The dancer's artistry amazed everyone in the audience.
meanings.exampleTr: Dansçının sanatkârlığı seyircideki herkesi hayran bıraktı.

meanings.en: the grey powder left after something has burned
meanings.exampleEn: After the fire, only ash remained where the house had stood.
meanings.exampleTr: Yangından sonra evin durduğu yerde sadece kül kaldı.

meanings.en: a strong desire to achieve something
meanings.exampleEn: Her greatest aspiration was to become a doctor.
meanings.exampleTr: En büyük emeli doktor olmaktı.

meanings.en: to direct one's hopes towards achieving something
meanings.exampleEn: Many young people aspire to start their own businesses.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok genç kendi işini kurmayı hedefler.

meanings.en: a violent physical or verbal attack
meanings.exampleEn: The man was arrested for assault after the fight.
meanings.exampleTr: Adam kavgadan sonra saldırı suçundan tutuklandı.

meanings.tr: toplamak, bir araya getirmek, monte etmek
meanings.en: to gather together or put parts together
meanings.exampleEn: The workers assemble the cars on the factory line.
meanings.exampleTr: İşçiler arabaları fabrika hattında monte eder.

meanings.en: a group of people gathered together for a purpose
meanings.exampleEn: The whole school met in the hall for the morning assembly.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün okul sabah toplantısı için salonda buluştu.

meanings.en: to evaluate or judge the quality or value of something
meanings.exampleEn: Teachers assess students' progress at the end of each term.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmenler her dönem sonunda öğrencilerin gelişimini değerlendirir.

meanings.en: the act of judging or evaluating something
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor made a quick assessment of the patient's condition.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor hastanın durumunun hızlı bir değerlendirmesini yaptı.

meanings.en: something accepted as true without proof
meanings.exampleEn: His plan was based on the assumption that prices would fall.
meanings.exampleTr: Planı fiyatların düşeceği varsayımına dayanıyordu.

meanings.en: a promise or statement that gives confidence
meanings.exampleEn: The manager gave us his assurance that the work would be finished on time.
meanings.exampleTr: Müdür işin zamanında biteceğine dair bize güvence verdi.

meanings.en: to tell someone confidently that something is true
meanings.exampleEn: I assure you that everything will be fine.
meanings.exampleTr: Sizi temin ederim ki her şey yolunda olacak.

meanings.en: to surprise someone very greatly
meanings.exampleEn: The magician's tricks never fail to astonish the crowd.
meanings.exampleTr: Sihirbazın numaraları kalabalığı şaşırtmaktan hiç geri kalmaz.

meanings.en: very surprised by something
meanings.exampleEn: She was astonished to see how much the city had changed.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehrin ne kadar değiştiğini görünce çok şaşırmıştı.

meanings.en: extremely surprising or impressive
meanings.exampleEn: The team made astonishing progress in just one month.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım sadece bir ayda şaşırtıcı bir ilerleme kaydetti.

meanings.en: a feeling of great surprise
meanings.exampleEn: To my astonishment, the door opened by itself.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayretler içinde, kapı kendiliğinden açıldı.

meanings.en: the scientific study of stars, planets and space
meanings.exampleEn: He studied astronomy to learn more about distant galaxies.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzak galaksiler hakkında daha fazla şey öğrenmek için astronomi okudu.

meanings.en: sports such as running, jumping and throwing
meanings.exampleEn: She won a gold medal in athletics at the Olympics.
meanings.exampleTr: Olimpiyatlarda atletizmde altın madalya kazandı.

meanings.en: joined or connected to something, or fond of someone
meanings.exampleEn: The children became very attached to their new teacher.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar yeni öğretmenlerine çok bağlandı.

meanings.en: able to be achieved or reached
meanings.exampleEn: Set goals that are realistic and attainable.
meanings.exampleTr: Gerçekçi ve ulaşılabilir hedefler belirleyin.

meanings.en: the act of achieving something, or a thing achieved
meanings.exampleEn: The school is proud of the high attainment of its students.
meanings.exampleTr: Okul, öğrencilerinin yüksek başarısıyla gurur duyuyor.

meanings.en: the number of people present, or the act of being present
meanings.exampleEn: Attendance at the meeting was higher than expected.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantıya katılım beklenenden yüksekti.

meanings.en: paying close attention; listening carefully
meanings.exampleEn: The students were attentive during the whole lecture.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrenciler ders boyunca dikkatliydi.

meanings.en: in a way that shows careful attention
meanings.exampleEn: She listened attentively to her grandmother's stories.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyükannesinin hikayelerini dikkatlice dinledi.

meanings.en: the quality of being pleasing or appealing
meanings.exampleEn: The attractiveness of the offer made it hard to refuse.
meanings.exampleTr: Teklifin çekiciliği onu reddetmeyi zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: a quality or feature of someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: Patience is an important attribute for a good teacher.
meanings.exampleTr: Sabır, iyi bir öğretmen için önemli bir özelliktir.

meanings.en: not typical or usual; different from the norm
meanings.exampleEn: This warm weather is atypical for winter.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu sıcak hava kış için alışılmadık bir durum.

meanings.en: a dark purple vegetable, also called eggplant
meanings.exampleEn: She cooked the aubergine with garlic and olive oil.
meanings.exampleTr: Patlıcanı sarımsak ve zeytinyağıyla pişirdi.

meanings.en: a short performance to test a performer's suitability
meanings.exampleEn: He was nervous before his audition for the play.
meanings.exampleTr: Oyun için verdiği seçmeden önce gergindi.

meanings.en: reliable and respected as a source of knowledge
meanings.exampleEn: This book is an authoritative guide to ancient history.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kitap, antik tarih için güvenilir bir rehberdir.

meanings.en: to give official permission for something
meanings.exampleEn: The manager must authorize all large payments.
meanings.exampleTr: Müdür tüm büyük ödemeleri onaylamalıdır.

meanings.en: the state of being able to be obtained or used
meanings.exampleEn: Please check the availability of rooms before booking.
meanings.exampleTr: Rezervasyon yapmadan önce lütfen odaların mevcudiyetini kontrol edin.

meanings.en: to wait for something or someone
meanings.exampleEn: We eagerly await your reply to our letter.
meanings.exampleTr: Mektubumuza vereceğiniz yanıtı sabırsızlıkla bekliyoruz.

meanings.en: a feeling of great respect mixed with wonder
meanings.exampleEn: The tourists stared in awe at the enormous mountain.
meanings.exampleTr: Turistler devasa dağa hayranlıkla baktı.

meanings.en: a tool with a heavy blade used for cutting wood
meanings.exampleEn: He used an ax to chop the firewood.
meanings.exampleTr: Odunları kesmek için bir balta kullandı.

meanings.en: a real or imaginary line around which something turns
meanings.exampleEn: The Earth rotates on its axis once every day.
meanings.exampleTr: Dünya, her gün ekseni etrafında bir kez döner.

meanings.en: an extra copy or source of support kept for safety
meanings.exampleEn: Always keep a backup of your important files.
meanings.exampleTr: Önemli dosyalarınızın her zaman bir yedeğini saklayın.
